heading: Disposal of surplus buffalo and elk

tree.text: The Secretary of the Interior is authorized, in his discretion and under regulations to be prescribed by him, to sell or otherwise dispose of the surplus buffalo and elk of the Wind Cave National Park herd.
All moneys received from the sale of any such surplus animals, or products thereof, shall be deposited in the Treasury of the United States as miscellaneous receipts.

notes.text: Codification Subsecs. (a) and (b) of this section constitute sections 1 and 2, respectively, of act June 16, 1938.
